- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/05 (Fri) 18:52
- [EVENT] User is planning a road trip to the mountains in June.
- [EVENT] User wants to ensure their bike is in good condition for the road trip.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant does not have access to the user's personal information or bike service history.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended contacting the bike shop for service records.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised inspecting the bike for signs of wear and tear, including worn-out tires, rusty chains, or loose bolts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of items to check before the road trip: tire pressure and tread condition, brake pads and cables, chain condition and lubrication, gear system and derailleurs, bolts and screws, seat and handlebars.
- [EVENT] User remembers taking their bike in for a tune-up on April 20th.
- [EVENT] User had issues with stuck gears during the last service.
- [EVENT] User replaced the chain during the last service, which cost $25.
- [EVENT] User had a new set of bike lights installed during the last service, which cost $40.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant expressed willingness to help create a bike maintenance schedule.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a general bike maintenance schedule:
  - Monthly: Check tire pressure, inspect tire tread, clean and lubricate the chain, check brake pads and cables, ensure bolts and screws are secure.
  - Every 3-6 months: Inspect and clean derailleurs and chainrings, check gear system, inspect brake calipers and pads, check bike's bolts and screws.
  - Every 6-12 months: Replace the chain, inspect and replace brake cables and housing, inspect and clean wheels, consider a professional bike inspection and tune-up.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised keeping a record of maintenance activities and referring to the bike's manual for specific recommendations.
- [EVENT] User has clocked 347 miles on their bike since the start of the year.
- [EVENT] User's goal is to reach 1000 miles by the end of summer.

  - Ride with GPS
  - Strava
  - Local bike shops for route recommendations.
